name: yieldshield-bnb
description: YieldShield on BNB Chain: BSC Testnet trading and protection with read-only mainnet token scenarios.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @yieldshield/core && npm run build -w @yieldshield/sdk && npm run build -w @yieldshield/adapter-solana && npm run build -w @yieldshield/adapter-evm
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @yieldshield/core && npm run build -w @yieldshield/sdk
scripts.test:base: node --test services/base-market-data.test.mjs scripts/deploy-base-sepolia.test.mjs scripts/base-receipts.test.mjs && vitest run packages/adapter-evm/test/security.test.ts
scripts.test:bnb: node --test services/bnb-market-data.test.mjs scripts/bsc-deployment.test.mjs scripts/publish-bsc-deployment.test.mjs && vitest run packages/adapter-evm/test/security.test.ts packages/adapter-evm/test/faucet.test.ts packages/adapter-evm/test/demo-trading.test.ts
